_source: Reference limits from Washington State freshwater criteria (WAC 173-201A-200), assuming core summer salmonid habitat and primary contact recreation. Use designations differ by stream and these have not been approved for this project; confirm with the data owner. Edit this file to change them.

water_temperature.basis: Core summer salmonid habitat. The criterion is a 7-day average of daily maximums; a single reading only approximates it.

dissolved_oxygen.basis: Core summer salmonid habitat, lowest 1-day minimum.

ecoli.basis: Primary contact recreation: no more than 10% of samples above 320 per 100 mL (the geometric mean limit is 100).
